name: 説明と二つの選択欄を持つ国・言語設定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0107 説明と二つの選択欄を持つ国・言語設定.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render exactly one Japanese country-and-language settings panel using only the source crop at normalized region x=20,y=145,w=350,h=271 on a 390px screen. Keep the question at the top, then the country selector, language selector, and primary completion action in that order. Preserve exactly these six strings and no others: どの国・地域と言語で利用しますか？; 国・地域; 米国; 言語; 英語; 完了. Keep the small US flag before 米国 and a clear right-pointing chevron at the right end of both selector rows. Use two separate white outlined rows, about 64px high each, with modest corner radii and comfortable internal padding. Keep the action full-width within the same 350px content region, about 42px high, with a restrained rounded shape. Use compact but comfortable vertical rhythm: a short question-to-row gap, about 10px between rows, and a modest 18-22px gap before 完了. Preserve the preview's role-specific Meiryo sizes, weights, line heights, and wrapping; do not enlarge the text or compress it to manufacture density. No title bar, back/cancel controls, status/navigation chrome, footer, outer card, duplicate rows, or decorative content. Use a pure white canvas with minimal surrounding presentation whitespace.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Keep flat white surfaces, fine neutral outlines, slate chevrons, and the original small US flag. Render 完了 as the only forest-green gradient primary action with white text. Do not add broad mint, a toolbar, or extra controls.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.
reviewNotes: Candidate-only v001. The 350x271 actual-size view confirms all six strings, US flag, two right chevrons, and green 完了 action. Needs correction: selector rows are about 52-54px and action about 35px versus source about 63px and 44px; question sits about 50px from the top, leaving excess blank space. No owner approval, native editability, application implementation, or runtime acceptance claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
